fixed_paragraph: When I walk into a room full of people, I immediately start chatting with everyone. When I hear music playing, I can't help but start dancing. When I meet someone new, I eagerly introduce myself and ask them questions. When there's a group activity, I jump right in and take the lead. When I see someone sitting alone, I go over and strike up a conversation. When I'm at a party, I make sure to talk to as many people as possible. When I have free time, I prefer to spend it with friends rather than being alone. When there's an opportunity to try something new, I enthusiastically say yes. When I hear laughter, I join in and add to the fun.
